# P34.34a — Release-archive link depth + same-origin crawl + archive chrome

**Requirement ids cited (context, not owned):** SIG-FIND-001/002 · SIG-UI-033 ·
SIG-UI-024 · SIG-LIC-011 · SIG-UI-049.
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/241_P34.34a__release-archive-link-depth-and-crawl.md`
(manifest row 241, Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Base:**
`r11/P34.48-re-verdict-61-boilerplate-coverage-rows` (chain tip `84bd5eff`) ·
**Gate:** none · **Live stage:** none (`live_verification=false`) ·
**Production mutations:** none · **OM-20:** not an OM-20 row ·
**CI config changed:** no.

## Why

Before the pre-release archive can be exposed, every same-origin link on an
exports-rendered page must resolve, and every page must carry the chrome an
honest archive needs: site navigation, a dispute/correction route, and the
licence of the data shown. The nested `r/<pub>/c/<comp>/…` routes emitted
depth-fragile `../../` links that resolved outside the release; there was no
mechanical check; access-typed edges lost their kind in export; dossiers did
not state their provisional posture; a zero-record release looked like a
broken build; `web/leverage.json` could be silently absent; and a zero-tile
export failed the web build rather than stating the absence.

## What ships

- **Link-depth fix + crawl gate** (`exports/release.py`,
  `exports/release_pages.py`): record/evidence links are now site-root-absolute
  (`/r/<pub>/c/<comp>/…`), removing the depth bug by construction.
  `link_crawl_failures` parses `href`/`action` on every rendered `.html`,
  resolves same-origin targets (fragments, query-only, external schemes and
  protocol-relative ignored; directory routes resolve through `index.html`),
  allows only an enumerated set of site-shell/overlay routes, and names page +
  target on failure. `validate_release` runs it on the release tree;
  `activate` re-runs it on the composed `staged/` tree after withdrawal
  tombstones so denied routes resolve as honest 410s.
- **Archive chrome** (`release_pages.py`): one `_layout` emits site nav, the
  `/dispute/` link and the data-licence line on every page type
  (record, evidence, browse, jurisdiction, compartment, dossier, landing,
  index, entity stub, search, tombstone/error — tombstones carry no licence
  claim rather than a fabricated one).
- **Edge access types** (`shaping.py`, `spine_export.py`,
  `published_record.py`): `record_claims` rows and `ClaimAnchor`s carry
  `access_kind` (`configured_access` / `observed_use` / `declared_policy` /
  `unclassified`); a materialized edge's recorded kind wins for its
  `evidence_claim`; the field is sparse so non-edge bytes are unchanged.
  `shaping._classify_access_kind` delegates to
  `reconcile.materialize.classify_access_kind` — the unsafe bare
  `"use" in predicate` rule is gone.
- **Dossier posture + landing links**: dossier pages state they are computed
  inventory overviews, not human-adjudicated findings; release landings link
  every emitted dossier and label the list provisional/computed; zero-record
  landings state "verified empty publication" rather than looking broken.
- **`web/leverage.json`** (`spine_export.py`): emitted on every spine export —
  the recorded `osm_changeset_feeds` folded through `LeverageLedger`, else the
  honest zeroed ledger. No live fetch (operator-bound replay, HG-08); the web
  data layer keeps failing loud on a missing file.
- **Empty tiles** (`astro.config.mjs`, `web/scripts/export-tiles.mjs`,
  `web/src/lib/map-tiles.ts`, `web/src/pages/map.astro`): a zero-archive tile
  manifest no longer fails the build (missing manifest / listed-but-absent
  archive still fail loud); export mode with zero archives renders the honest
  `EMPTY_TILE_STATE_NOTE` and the background-only style.

## Also fixed (found by the new tests)

- `validate_release` read `scope.get("indexed_records") or -1` — a legitimate
  `0` scope was misread as missing, so a zero-record release was
  unvalidatable.
- `ops/journey_verify.py` `A.browse_exhaustive` pinned the old
  `../../entity/…` needle; updated to the root-absolute shape (same intent:
  every record reachable by no-JS pagination).
- `tests/unit/test_p34_20_producer_check.py` documents `build_spine_export`
  as a second declared producer of `web/leverage.json`.
